a: The ID of the metastore federation. The id must contain only letters (a-z, A-Z), numbers (0-9), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). Cannot begin or end with underscore or hyphen.
The Apache Hive metastore version of the federation. All backend metastore versions must be compatible with the federation version.
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the federation. Defaults to false.
User-defined labels for the metastore federation. **Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the labels present in your configuration.
The location where the metastore federation should reside.
The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
A map of resource manager tags. Resource manager tag keys and values have the same definition as resource manager tags.
The type of the backend metastore. Possible values: ["METASTORE_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED", "DATAPROC_METASTORE", "BIGQUERY"]
The relative resource name of the metastore that is being federated. The formats of the relative resource names for the currently supported metastores are listed below: Dataplex:…
The identifier for this object. Format specified above.

The ID of the metastore service. The id must contain only letters (a-z, A-Z), numbers (0-9), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). Cannot begin or end with underscore or hyphen. Must consist of between 3 and 63 characters.
The database type that the Metastore service stores its data. Default value: "MYSQL" Possible values: ["MYSQL", "SPANNER"]
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
Indicates if the dataproc metastore should be protected against accidental deletions.
User-defined labels for the metastore service. **Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the labels present in your configuration.
The location where the metastore service should reside. The default value is 'global'.
The relative resource name of the VPC network on which the instance can be accessed. It is specified in the following form: "projects/{projectNumber}/global/networks/{network_id}".
The TCP port at which the metastore service is reached. Default: 9083.
The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
The release channel of the service. If unspecified, defaults to 'STABLE'. Default value: "STABLE" Possible values: ["CANARY", "STABLE"]
A map of resource manager tags. Resource manager tag keys and values have the same definition as resource manager tags.
The tier of the service. Possible values: ["DEVELOPER", "ENTERPRISE"]
The fully qualified customer provided Cloud KMS key name to use for customer data encryption. Use the following format: 'projects/([^/]+)/locations/([^/]+)/keyRings/([^/]+)/cryptoKeys/([^/]+)'
A mapping of Hive metastore configuration key-value pairs to apply to the Hive metastore (configured in hive-site.xml). The mappings override system defaults (some keys cannot be overridden)
The protocol to use for the metastore service endpoint. If unspecified, defaults to 'THRIFT'. Default value: "THRIFT" Possible values: ["THRIFT", "GRPC"]
The identifier for this object. Format specified above.
The Hive metastore version of the auxiliary service. It must be less than the primary Hive metastore service's version.
A mapping of Hive metastore configuration key-value pairs to apply to the auxiliary Hive metastore (configured in hive-site.xml) in addition to the primary version's overrides.
A Cloud Storage URI that specifies the path to a krb5.conf file. It is of the form gs://{bucket_name}/path/to/krb5.conf, although the file does not need to be named krb5.conf explicitly.
A Kerberos principal that exists in the both the keytab the KDC to authenticate as. A typical principal is of the form "primary/instance@REALM", but there is no exact format.
The relative resource name of a Secret Manager secret version, in the following form: "projects/{projectNumber}/secrets/{secret_id}/versions/{version_id}".
The day of week, when the window starts. Possible values: ["MONDAY", "TUESDAY", "WEDNESDAY", "THURSDAY", "FRIDAY", "SATURDAY", "SUNDAY"]
The hour of day (0-23) when the window starts.
Defines whether the metastore metadata should be synced to Data Catalog. The default value is to disable syncing metastore metadata to Data Catalog.
The subnetwork of the customer project from which an IP address is reserved and used as the Dataproc Metastore service's endpoint.
Scaling factor, in increments of 0.1 for values less than 1.0, and increments of 1.0 for values greater than 1.0.
Defines whether autoscaling is enabled. The default value is false.
The maximum scaling factor that the service will autoscale to. The default value is 6.0.
The minimum scaling factor that the service will autoscale to. The default value is 0.1.
A Cloud Storage URI of a folder, in the format gs://<bucket_name>/<path_inside_bucket>. A sub-folder <backup_folder> containing backup files will be stored below it.
The scheduled interval in Cron format, see https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cron The default is empty: scheduled backup is not enabled. Must be specified to enable scheduled backups.
Defines whether the scheduled backup is enabled. The default value is false.
Specifies the time zone to be used when interpreting cronSchedule. Must be a time zone name from the time zone database (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_tz_database_time_zones), e.g.
The output format of the Dataproc Metastore service's logs. Default value: "JSON" Possible values: ["LEGACY", "JSON"]
